Register PESTO's GP surrogate as a flexyBayes C7 conformer

Source: R/surrogate_conformers.R
register_pesto_surrogates.Rd

Makes method = "gp" available to fit_surrogate() by registering an adapter around PESTO's train_gp_surrogate() / predict_gp_surrogate(). PESTO's GP already reports a per-output predictive mean and variance, so the adapter only reshapes its output into the contract-C7 <o>_mean / <o>_sd data.frame (inst/surrogate_contract.md) – PESTO's surrogate is consumed through the registry, never copied into flexyBayes.

Usage

register_pesto_surrogates()

Value

Invisibly, the registered method name ("gp").

Details

Called opportunistically from .onLoad() when PESTO is installed, so the method is usually already available; call it explicitly to (re-)register.

See also

register_surrogate(), fit_surrogate(), register_kernr_surrogates().
